items.text: Adaptability skills mean changing your plan, tools or approach when the situation changes without losing quality, and you build them by deliberately learning one new tool, taking one unfamiliar task and writing down what you changed and why.
Adaptability is shown by a story where the plan changed and the result still held.
Read the notice to see whether it points to tools, shifts, clients or team changes.
